input-field.name: enabled
input-field.label: Enable the quote agent
input-field.helpText: Off by default. While off the agent is completely silent: it queues nothing and writes nothing.

input-field.name: agentDisplayName
input-field.label: Name shown to buyers
input-field.helpText: What the buyer sees above the agent's messages in their quote conversation, instead of "Merchant". Give your agent a name if you prefer, e.g. "Peter the AI". One name for all languages. Leave empty to fall back to "AI Agent" — a blank name would render the buyer's messages unattributed.

input-field.name: draftMode
input-field.label: Draft Mode: review every reply before it is sent
input-field.helpText: The agent prepares every reply and price change but never sends them. Each draft waits for you under Orders › Quote agent, where you can edit, send or reject it. The buyer hears nothing from the agent directly — not even that a human is looking at the quote.

input-field.name: llmApiKey
input-field.label: LLM API key
input-field.helpText: Your own key. Stored in system_config, obscured here but NOT encrypted at rest. Set MQA_LLM_API_KEY in the environment instead to keep it out of the database entirely — when that is set, this field is ignored.

input-field.name: llmBaseUrl
input-field.label: LLM base URL
input-field.helpText: Point at Azure, your own gateway or a self-hosted model.

input-field.name: llmModel
input-field.label: Model name
input-field.helpText: The model to send each request to, e.g. gpt-4o-mini. Required: there is deliberately no default, because guessing one would pick a price and quality point for you.

input-field.name: maxDiscountPercent
input-field.label: Maximum discount (%)
input-field.helpText: 0 means every price ask escalates to a human.

input-field.name: counterOfferMaxPercent
input-field.label: Counter-offer ceiling (%)
input-field.helpText: An ask above the maximum but at or below this gets a deterministic counter at the maximum. Blank means no counter band.

input-field.name: minMarginPercent
input-field.label: Minimum margin on purchase price (%)
input-field.helpText: The agent never prices a product below its purchase price plus this markup: a purchase price of 100 and 10 here make 110 the lowest it may offer. It lowers an offer to that floor instead of escalating. Products without a purchase price have no floor. Blank means off; 0 means never below cost.

input-field.name: roundingMode
input-field.label: Round the agent's offers

option.name: Off: offers go out exactly as computed

input-field.helpText: Rounding only ever gives less discount, so it never breaks the limits above. It never rounds a figure the customer asked for, never takes back a discount they already hold, and never rounds a discount away to nothing: in each case the offer goes out unrounded. Both modes round quote-wide offers only: an offer that sets individual line prices goes out as the agent priced it. Quote-total rounding writes a fixed-amount discount.

input-field.name: roundingStep
input-field.label: Rounding step
input-field.helpText: Percentage points when rounding the discount (0.5 turns 7.34% into 7.0%); your currency when rounding the total the customer sees, shipping included (10 turns 12,356.12 into 12,360.00). Blank or 0 means off whatever you picked above.

input-field.name: maxQuoteValueNet
input-field.label: Maximum quote value for negotiation (net)
input-field.helpText: Above this net total the quote always escalates. Stated net, and compared against the quote's net total whatever currency the quote is in — so set it in the currency you actually sell in. Blank means no ceiling at all.

input-field.name: validityDays
input-field.label: Default offer validity (days)
input-field.helpText: How long an offer the agent sends stays valid. At least 1: a blank or zero value takes this sales channel out of service rather than sending offers that have already expired.

input-field.name: escalationSlaHours
input-field.label: Escalation SLA (hours)
input-field.helpText: How long the deal desk has to answer an escalated quote. Used only to benchmark the dashboard's escalation resolution time — it does not change what the agent does or what it may grant. Blank means no benchmark.

input-field.name: notifyBuyerOnEscalation
input-field.label: Notify buyer when escalated to a human
input-field.helpText: When enabled, posts a storefront comment informing the buyer that their quote has been passed to a team member for manual review. When disabled, escalates silently without sending an automated comment to the buyer.

input-field.name: assistantQuoteRequests
input-field.label: Let the shopping assistant request quotes
input-field.helpText: When enabled, and the shopping-assistant-starter-kit plugin is installed, the assistant can turn a shopper's cart into a quote request in that shopper's name. Off by default: this acts for the buyer, so it is opted into rather than switched on by installing two plugins.
